each: Fresh headless browser profile and distinct run/slot id per case. Lifecycle: write-task running, task written, real ledger error, recovered, task without criteria; never rewound.
movement: Change in distance from the pipeline top to the next control between write-task running and criteria shown. Content loading above moves both; a shrink at the page scroll limit moves only the pipeline.
boundaries: A real ledger error keeps its existing auto-expanded panel, so that state grows by its error rows.
A written task without criteria releases the reserved row once its read settles.
Before recordings also show a resource-store restart notice from the archived base tree; it is not asserted, and the read-guard control reproduces the false read without it.
limit: Mounted Command Center over an isolated observed-WebSocket protocol fixture. No gateway, task writer, worker, native host or device is started.
